seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Winnipeg - No Home Help
seo.description: Current Winnipeg contacts for emergency shelter access, day services, food, health care, benefits, jobs and other help for people without stable housing.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Winnipeg
page.urgent: For immediate danger or a life-threatening medical emergency, call the local emergency number shown below.
page.notice: Shelters and services can be full, change hours or require an assessment or referral. Call before travelling whenever possible. No listing guarantees a bed, housing, treatment, benefits or a job.
page.intro: If one shelter is full, try the other local services and the referral lines below. Ask about day centres, outreach, food, hygiene, health care and the next safe option; do not rely on a single address.

entries.title: Winnipeg crisis response
entries.description: Municipal/provincial crisis assessment and social support. Call 911 for immediate danger; ask 211 for additional shelter and warming options.

entries.title: 911 — emergency services
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, overdose, fire or another life-threatening emergency.

entries.title: 211 Canada — local service referrals
entries.description: Call 211 or search by location for shelter, food, health, outreach and social services. Ask for several alternatives if one shelter is full.

entries.title: Main Street Project
entries.description: Emergency shelter, drop-in, meals, outreach and case management. Capacity changes; call or visit the official page before travelling and ask for another option if full.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check the official page before travelling. Capacity is not guaranteed; ask about eligibility, documents, referral rules and an alternative if the service is full.

entries.title: Centre of Hope — emergency shelter
entries.description: Emergency and transitional shelter. Intake is assessed and space is limited; phone first.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check the official page before travelling. Capacity is not guaranteed; ask about eligibility, documents, referral rules and an alternative if the service is full.

entries.title: 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline
entries.description: Call or text 988 for crisis support. Call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: Government of Canada Benefits Finder
entries.description: Official questionnaire for federal and provincial benefits. It does not guarantee approval or immediate money.

entries.title: Job Bank
entries.description: Official job search, employment service and training information across Canada.
